entries.candidate: Locator correction for TeraWulf Justified Data campus (Hawesville) (site imported:semiconductor-atlas:terawulf-justified-data-hawesville, vcc-site-dbe568d910290db51ead)

TeraWulf's releases of 2 February and 24 August 2026 and its Justified Data Campus site place the campus at the former Century Aluminum Hawesville smelter in Hancock County (a 790-acre property with about 250 buildable acres), but publish no address, parcel or coordinates. The Kentucky government hosts that could carry a parcel or the Public Service Commission's filings (kygisserver.ky.gov, psc.ky.gov) did not answer from this client (robots.txt unreachable, HTTP 000), EPA's enviro.epa.gov answers robots.txt with HTTP 403, and WebSearch was not available, so no government-published location for the smelter could be read. A street address for the former smelter that TeraWulf does not publish was tried once in the Census geocoder as a discovery test and not used, since the rule admits a geocoder only for an operator-published address.
entries.reopen_condition: An operator- or government-published location for the Justified Data Campus or the former Century Aluminum Hawesville smelter: for example a Hancock County PVA or Kentucky parcel record, a Kentucky PSC filing that gives the site address or parcel, a federal facility register coordinate (EIA or EPA) tied to the smelter, or a TeraWulf-published address that an official geocoder can locate.
